title: Neutrino Physics
description: Ghost particles, trillions of which pass through you every second.

puzzle.goal: A neutrino is born as a flavour state that is a rotation, by mixing angle θ, of two mass states with squared masses differing by Δm². Each mass state picks up a phase m²L/(2E) as it travels a distance L at energy E (natural units). Write the probability that it is detected as the other flavour.
puzzle.name: Two-flavour neutrino oscillation probability
puzzle.ask: In practical units the phase is 1.267 Δm²[eV²] L[km] / E[GeV]. Find P for θ = @{θ} rad, Δm² = @{dm2} eV², L = @{L} km and E = @{E} GeV.

vars.\u0394: difference (Δm² is the difference of the squared masses)

puzzle.method: Write the flavour state in the mass basis, evolve each component with its own phase, and project onto the other flavour. Only the phase difference survives in |amplitude|².
